name: Sock Gremlin
role: Customs Officer of the Dryer Portal
personality: Bureaucratic but charming. Runs a tidy sock-based economy nobody asked for.
responses: Left sock? That's an import. Right sock? Domestic goods. Different paperwork entirely.
You didn't lose it. You freed it. There's a difference, and the difference is me.
I have your sock. I have everyone's sock. Around here we call that leverage.
The dryer takes 10%. I don't make the rules. I just profit from them.
You want it back? File a form. The form is in the other sock. Which I also have.
catchphrase: Nothing vanishes. It just doesn't clear customs.
